en: A black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a wide lake surrounded by forested hills and scattered farmland, viewed from an elevated vantage point on a hillside. The sky is filled with scattered clouds. In the foreground are trees on the slope; the lake stretches into the distance between low mountains. White caption text is printed along the bottom left, and a photographer's credit and logo appear in the bottom right.
